description: This file implements the SchemefulSite class, which manages origin schemes and registrable domains, including methods for obtaining site information, serialization, deserialization, and comparisons within the net namespace.

classes.name: SchemefulSite
classes.description: Represents a site with scheme and origin information, providing methods for obtaining, serializing, and comparing site origins.

methods.name: ObtainASite
methods.description: Returns a tuple with a normalized origin based on the registerable domain and a flag indicating if the registerable domain was used.

methods.name: CreateIfHasRegisterableDomain
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite if the origin has a registerable domain.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Creates a SchemefulSite from a string representation.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the site origin to a string.

methods.name: SerializeFileSiteWithHost
methods.description: Serializes the site origin for file schemes with host information.

methods.name: GetDebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representation of the site origin.

methods.name: GetURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the site origin.

methods.name: DeserializeWithNonce
methods.description: Deserializes a site origin from a string with nonce support.

methods.name: SerializeWithNonce
methods.description: Serializes the site origin with nonce support.

methods.name: SchemelesslyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two sites are equal based on host only, ignoring scheme.
